intro: Camping 101: Blacksmithing is an introductory task in Goldshire instructing smiths on crafting field equipment. By consulting Smith Argus, skilled metalworkers learn to forge a portable Sharpening Wheel for wilderness travels. It emphasizes field readiness, highlighting the necessity of open country and a proper campfire to establish a working campsite.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the adventurers and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
